title: CMU motion capture as a later movement-gap source
plainLanguage: CMU’s motion library can supply movement examples we do not yet have, but it should come later—after our perspective and attachment rules are strong enough to translate motion safely.
purpose: Keep a high-value future movement source on the roadmap without flooding the current corpus.

rules.statement: Use only selected movement gaps, not a bulk import.
Retarget into the universal skeleton/body-family context and review the result.
Do not resell the CMU data directly or in converted form.
Preserve source motion identity and original terms in every derived reference.

implementation.futureWork: Revisit when a concrete missing movement is identified.
